supporting_quotes.section: LAADS file specification MOD09GQ (mapping of original L2G files)

rows.mapping_note: MOD09 is named as the input of MOD_PRMGR.exe, whose 250 m output MOD09GQK (not in CMR) is what MOD_PR09G.exe turns into MOD09GQ; one non-archived intermediate in between, so the statement criterion is treated as weak. Version 6.1NRT matched.
rows.decision_procedure: Step 1b Q1 no. Q2 yes: T is made from MOD09's data: MOD_PRMGR.exe (PGE12) maps all MOD09 L2 granules of a day onto each sinusoidal tile (multi-observation 250 m L2G, MOD09GQK), and MOD_PR09G.exe (PGE13) sorts and compacts those observations into MOD09GQ -> aggregated_from (PARENT). PARENT vs INPUT: reprocessing MOD09 changes every MOD09GQ reflectance. MOD09GQK is not in CMR; the link is recorded against MOD09 (curator judgment call, same as the MOD09GA run).

supporting_quotes.quote: For the 250m product, the first criteria is that the 250m observation has to be from the same orbit as the 500m observation in the same layer.
